name: emami-hub-auth-backend
description: EmamiApps hub login (direct email in hub-auth.js, Microsoft SAML 2.0 in saml-sso.js) and Manage Access API (Postgres-backed authorized-user/app-grant storage) — deployed as an AWS Lambda (see lambda.js) via scripts/deploy-lambdas.js, fronted by API Gateway (not a Function URL, which was blocked by an unresolved AWS-account-level access issue).
